Congress Links Ankita Bhandari Case Accused to Governor Appointment

Congress leader Kumari Selja attacked the BJP over the appointment of a leader allegedly linked to the Ankita Bhandari case as a governor. Selja stated that this appointment is a grave disregard for democracy and justice. Rahul Gandhi also wrote to the President seeking a halt to Dushyant Gautam's appointment as governor in connection with the Ankita Bhandari case.
